description: For a classy and functional home decor, wall accessories play a big time role. IMAX 2511 large wall clock with pendulum adds a vintage appeal to your home or office wherever applied. Inspired by vintage Parisian cafes this large wall clock delivers old-world charm and rustic look. Large roman numerals make it easy to see the time and a pendulum adds a rhythmic and beautiful accent to the face. This decorative wall clock is battery powered, making it easy to display anywhere. Engineered wood clock is highly durable. Retro wall accessory uses the aged, distressed look in a restrained way to ensure the presentation is unique.
